name: pushary
description: Push notifications and human-in-the-loop for AI agents. Get a push when a task finishes, and answer the agent from your phone while you are away from the keyboard.

interface.shortDescription: Answer your AI agent from your phone.
interface.longDescription: Pushary reaches you on your phone while an agent works. It sends a push when a long task finishes or fails, and it can ask you a question, yes or no, multiple choice, or free text, and wait for the answer from your lock screen. Every question and answer is recorded, so there is a trail of what was asked and what you decided. Works alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Hermes, so several agents land in one inbox instead of several terminals.
defaultPrompt: Use Pushary to notify me on my phone when this finishes.
Ask me on my phone whether to deploy this, then wait for my answer.
Keep working and send me a push if you hit an error you cannot resolve.
